alterations.description: Shots from artificial respiration scene where Rosanna's bare bust is seen.
Scene of Giulio trying to go closer to Rosanna and Rosanna moving away, and Giulio's dialogue.
Lines from Taras Bulba's song comparing ladies' beds to ladles' beds.
From Filipenko's dialogue to Andrei, words about Baltic princes' gold and women's hips.
Scenes of revelry showing a girl's bare leg and thigh, and shots of Bulbas grabbing, spinning, and embracing her.
Frontal shots of Yvonne running towards Monica, showing her bust.
Fight between Bimbo and Kovacs in the circus tent, specifically shots where they thrust hands in each other's faces.
Charudutt entering a building.
Song starting with 'Mohamad Shah Rangeeley...', including the lines 'Hum Tose Milne Aaye...'.
Shot of Mohini sitting on a bed and crying.
Mohini at the Police Station enquiring about Mohan.
Scene of Azad on his way to Allahabad, a police raid, and Azad being encircled by police.
Scene of Krishnan Kutty refusing tea to 3 persons, up to Rajathi telling him he was being brave.
Song 3 (Dream Song) - mid-close shot of the dancer on background music before the last verse.
A boy taking up a bidi and blowing smoke.
At the police station, the Inspector informing Raghu about a fine and offering money, up to Raja accepting it.
Song 5 (Veettukku Vandha Machan) - Krishnan Kutty and Rajathi bumping each other (on background music after the second verse).
Raja giving a false statement to the police inspector; the inspector's speech about resigning his post; and the portion of the crowd scene at the police station where Krishnan Kutty is pushed out.
Scene of Krishnan Kutty and Rajathi at the beach, up to Melapalayalhal being taken away by her nephew for dinner.
During song No. 1, two shots of a bare-breasted woman.
Assault by Thangachcn on Rebecca, reduced to a bare suggestion.
Thangachcn paying money to two men. Reel 14 - portion where he pays the balance.
Scene of Kariachen paying money to Lazar and asking him to give false evidence.
Shots of the policemen missing the hiding Johney.
Song 11 - all shots of the execution of Thangachen.
